meta.description: How importers buy fresh fish from AZAFCO International: send your requirements, review them with our export team, then we pack and ship by air or road.

process.title: Four steps to your first shipment

steps.title: Send your requirements
steps.text: Company, country, species, weight grade, product form, quantity, packing and delivery date.

steps.title: Review with our export team
steps.text: We check supply, the specification, your market's requirements and the export documents it needs.

steps.title: Agree the order
steps.text: Species, grade, quantity, packing, transport, schedule and price are confirmed in writing for each order.

steps.title: Pack and ship
steps.text: We pack on ice and ship by air or road, with the export documents for your destination.

terms.title: Prices and terms
terms.text: We do not publish price lists. Price, minimum quantity, delivery terms and transit time depend on the species, weight grade, quantity and destination, and we confirm them in writing for each order.

faq.title: Questions importers ask before they start

who.a: AZAFCO International is an Egyptian company in Kafr El Sheikh, exporting since 2008. It farms and sources fish, then packs and exports it whole and fresh chilled. It packs up to 2,500 t/month at its plant in Motobas and ships to 7+ markets in the Middle East and beyond.

start.q: How do we start working together?
start.a: Send your requirements on our <req>requirements page</req>, or email the export team at business@azafco.com.eg for specifications and documents. WhatsApp management to discuss supply. We then review supply with you and confirm the commercial terms in writing.

grades.q: Which weight grades can you supply?
grades.a: Indicative weight grades are published on the species pages: {grades}. For the other species, send us your target weight range.

packing.a: Whole and fresh chilled, packed on ice in EPS foam boxes.

certificates.a: We hold ISO certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA. The standards are listed on our <quality>quality page</quality>.

shipping.a: Chilled, in our own refrigerated trucks from the plant, then by air or road freight depending on the destination.

markets.q: Which markets do you ship to?
markets.a: We ship to 7+ markets. The seven listed on this site are the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Lebanon, Qatar, Iraq and Syria. We are approved for export to the European Union; Russia and the USA are in our plan.

eu.q: Do you export to the European Union?
eu.a: Yes. We are approved for export to the European Union. Tell us the species, quantity and EU destination, and the export team confirms the documents for your shipment.

recurring.q: Do you take recurring supply programmes?
recurring.a: Yes. We pack up to 2,500 t/month. A refrigerated truck carries 20 t, and on some days more than five leave our plant. Tell us how many shipments you need a week or a month.

fraud.q: How do we know a message is really from AZAFCO International?
fraud.a: Our official channels are the export team email business@azafco.com.eg and the management WhatsApp +20 100 773 6419. If a message about your order comes from any other address or number, check it with us on these channels before you act on it.
